name: Handle HVAC Leak
description: Triage and dispatch for HVAC leaks at managed properties. Optimized for imminent-checkin scenarios with electrical-risk awareness.
workflow_steps: Classify severity and risk_tags via fast-tier LLM.
Retrieve top-3 voice memos + matched SOP + historical resolutions for property+category.
Reason via strong-tier LLM to draft dispatch with vendor + cost cap.
If severity >= 4 → AWAITING_HUMAN; else auto-authorize up to property cap.
Mock-WhatsApp the assigned operator; durable wait for ack or 30s escalation.
On resolve, propose a new rule if resolution pattern matches a candidate.
approval_rules: skip-vendor-fallback if preferred unavailable AND risk_tags includes electrical_risk
